text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":12,"unit":"pets","kind":"count","span":"less than the"},{"id":"q2","value":2,"unit":"cats","kind":"count","span":"two cats for"},{"id":"q3","value":60,"unit":"dogs","kind":"count","span":"dogs is 60"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q2","q3"],"out":"s1","note":"number of cats = two times the number of dogs"},{"op":"add","args":["q3","s1"],"out":"s2","note":"dogs plus cats combined"},{"op":"sub","args":["s2","q1"],"out":"s3","note":"rabbits = combined dogs and cats minus 12"},{"op":"add","args":["s2","s3"],"out":"s4","note":"total pets = dogs plus cats plus rabbits"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"total number of pets in the neighborhood"},"dismissed":[]}
